name: Earth (planet view) V22
description: Earth on its own, increment 22 of 22. The floating parts are brought closer to scale: rockets about 0.85 in tall, satellites on faded orbit lines (about 80 of them: a LEO constellation on four rings, the ISS, Hubble, a navigation ring, geostationary satellites and a polar weather satellite), storms about 2.5 in across on the cloud shell, and clouds just above the ground. The dot map, the Moon and the rest are as in V21. Exaggerated where the real size would vanish.
